Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL2955 (Sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor 2). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL2955, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
